row.proto: uint64_t Ne_PooledList_SetCapacity_Node24(void *list, uint64_t capacity, uint64_t arg3)
row.notes: (lib) Capacity change for a pooled intrusive list: [0] allocator, [1]/[2] node block chain, [3] free list, [4]/[5] list sentinel, [6] size, [7] capacity, [8] extra. Growing allocates a 0x28 block header plus (delta * 0x18) nodes and threads them onto the free list; shrinking pops nodes back to the free list, and a non-zero smaller capacity rebuilds through a temporary list (recursive call and helper 0x1435f63b0). Returns 0, or errno 0xc on allocation failure.
